name: Creation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

upcast.text: The Cube grows by 5 feet per slot level above 5.

summary: Shape a nonliving object of plant or mineral matter, up to a 5-foot Cube, out of shadow stuff.
text: It lasts by material: plant matter 24 hours, stone 12 hours, precious metals 1 hour, gems 10 minutes, adamantine or mithral 1 minute. Its material can't be used as a spell's material component.
